title: Summer A & B 2027 courses
institution: Friday Harbor Laboratories (FHL), University of Washington
field: Summer courses for credit at Friday Harbor Laboratories
about: Friday Harbor Laboratories (University of Washington) in Friday Harbor, United States accepts applications for its Summer A and B 2027 five-week courses for credit from December 15, 2026; priority deadline January 31, 2027. Instructors review applications and make acceptance decisions.
card_alt: Card for the Summer A & B 2027 courses at Friday Harbor Laboratories (FHL), University of Washington in Friday Harbor, United States, priority deadline 31 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Friday Harbor.
